stem: 一名反洗钱合规官正在评估新客户的资料。以下哪项最可能表明该客户存在洗钱风险？

options.A: 客户提供的信息与公开资料或业务活动不一致
options.B: 客户要求降低服务费用
options.C: 客户询问账户开立流程所需时间
options.D: 客户提供了完整的身份证明文件

stem_en: An AML compliance officer is evaluating a new customer's profile. Which of the following is most likely to indicate that the customer presents a money laundering risk?

options_en.A: The information provided by the customer is inconsistent with public records or business activity
options_en.B: The customer requests a reduction in service fees
options_en.C: The customer asks how long the account opening process will take
options_en.D: The customer provides complete identification documents
